source: GDD gdd/lanebound-champions-v4.0-notion.md (Lanebound v4.0, L7 kit); look from champions/portraits/painted/mirren/mirren-1024.png (CD-7)
note: Blue faces right and red faces left. Blit at (round(sx)-9, round(sy)-23). Team tint only on the strap clasp. Celadon apron and jade jar are paler and greener than Torun teal; the jar eye is kiln orange, not gold. Hex turns the unit into a jar with a 1 px team band.

idle.note: breath; tongs upright, the belt jar blinks on 3

attack.note: clay pellet (line, 5.5): tongs flick, pellet leaves the tong tips on 3

cast.note: generic cast: tongs raised, the jar eye glows

kiln.note: Passive Kiln-Cured: the belt jar opens its eye and glints; hexed enemies get an orange crack (+12% damage taken)

glaze.note: Q Glaze Spit: jar off the belt (1), lifted (2), tipped (3), glaze glob spat on 4 (0.28 s cast); lobbed, r 1.6 splash at up to 6 tiles

jarring.note: W Jarring: tongs drawn back (1), aimed (2), a clay lid flicked on 3 (0.25 s cast); single target hex 1.6 s (becomes a jar, 35% slow)

chorus.note: R Kiln Chorus: jar raised overhead (1), it sings (2-4), the kiln ring lands on 5 (0.55 s cast); r 2.8 at up to 8 tiles; hex 1.5 s + damage

death.note: tongs fall, she sits, jar rolls; last frame holds

hex.note: W hex 1.6 s / R hex 1.5 s: the unit becomes a small celadon jar (team band on the shoulder), hops at 65% speed, NEW hex plate; Kiln-Cured adds an orange crack glint
